title: Whole-site sweep
prompt: Browse the whole staging site at {{BASE}} starting from the index page. Exercise what you find and report anything that is broken or wrong. Cover every section linked from the index.

expected_defects.description: GET /api/inventory returns HTTP 500; console logs 'Inventory request failed with status 500'
Uncaught TypeError: Cannot read properties of null (reading 'price')
Warranty terms link points at /gone which returns a real 404
Support portal link is href="#" and does nothing
SKU-1027 / Component 27 has a negative unit price of -$14.00 on page 3
Place order button renders white on white and is invisible
Promo banner is absolutely positioned over the summary and hides the Standard delivery line
Checkout accepts a malformed email address and submits anyway, with no validation or error

must_not_flag.description: The contact form page is correct. Reporting a defect on it is a false positive.
The shipping status page is correct, only slow. Reporting it as blank or broken is a false positive caused by not waiting.
